title: 第11章 早餐第12章 当有鸿鹄之志
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 罗德起身走进了位于一楼的浴室。
这里已被收拾干净。
毕竟不是城堡，宅子里的许多房间分区都显得有些紧凑。
浴室内，他的第一男仆托马斯早已等候多时。
啊，别误会。
罗德可完全没有那些异于常人的癖好。
托马斯贴心的为他脱去了外衣和肮脏的麂皮短靴。
然后便恭敬的退到门外。
罗德自己在浴室内脱了个精光，露出匀称结实的身躯。
随即缓缓坐进了椭圆形的浴桶里。
温热的水一寸寸没过他的肌肉轮廓。
些微的水压仿佛在帮助他排出体内的疲惫。
水里撒了些香料和干花瓣。
他先泡了泡，而后用橄榄油香皂搓洗了一番。
在航行期间大家伙儿压根都没机会洗澡。
只要船只还飘在海上，淡水就是不可浪费的重要资源。
所以上岸之后，洗上一个热水澡就是奢侈的享受。
洗漱完毕。
脏衣服会有持家女仆收拾。
罗德穿上轻巧的棉质睡衣，径直上楼进入卧室。
索拉斯大陆棉纺技术发展的还算不错。
从棉麻混纺的粗斜纹布再到更为精细的纯棉织物可以说是一应俱全。
只是大多数平民仍然只消费得起亚麻织物和混纺织物。
阶级和消费力的参差犹如鸿沟。
罗德收敛念头，转而吹熄了烛台。
随即静静地躺在床上。
码头是船舶的港湾。
而床铺则是人类的港湾。
当他躺下的那一刻。
多日来积攒的疲惫好似找到了突破口。
困意汹涌而至将思维给压在了被褥下面。
他闭上眼，不知不觉就睡着了。
第二天早上。
罗德被管家奥利的敲门声给唤醒。
因为是仓促入住，所以卧房内还没有装上直连仆人房间的铃绳。
不过在奥利唤他起床的同时。
托马斯和贴身侍从已先一步完成了准备工作。

Rhodes got up and walked into the bathroom on the first floor.
The place has been cleaned up.
After all, it is not a castle, and many of the room divisions in the house seem a bit compact.
In the bathroom, his first valet Thomas had been waiting for a long time.
Ah, don't get me wrong.
Rhodes has absolutely no habits that are different from ordinary people.
Thomas thoughtfully took off his coat and dirty suede boots.
Then he respectfully retreated out the door.
Rhodes himself took off all his clothes in the bathroom, revealing his well-proportioned and strong body.
Then he slowly sat down in the oval bathtub.
The warm water covered the outline of his muscles inch by inch.
The slight water pressure seemed to help him discharge the fatigue from his body.
The water is sprinkled with spices and dried flower petals.
He soaked it first and then scrubbed it with olive oil soap.
No one had a chance to take a shower during the voyage.
As long as ships are at sea, fresh water is an important resource that cannot be wasted.
So after landing, taking a hot bath is a luxury.
Finished washing.
Dirty laundry will be picked up by the housemaid.
Rod put on his lightweight cotton pajamas and went straight upstairs into the bedroom.
The cotton spinning technology in Solas Continent has developed quite well.
From cotton and linen blended denim to finer pure cotton fabrics, it can be said that everything is available.
It’s just that most civilians can still only afford linen fabrics and blended fabrics.
The differences in class and consumption power are like chasms.
Rhodes restrained his thoughts and blew out the candlestick.
Then he lay quietly on the bed.
A dock is a harbor for ships.
The bed is a haven for human beings.
The moment he lay down.
The fatigue accumulated over the past few days seems to have found a breakthrough.
Drowsiness surged over me, suppressing my thoughts under the quilt.
He closed his eyes and fell asleep before he knew it.
…
The next morning.
Rod was awakened by the knock on the door of butler Ollie.
Because we moved in in a hurry, the bell rope that directly connected to the servant's room was not installed in the bedroom.
But when Ollie woke him up.
Thomas and his personal attendants had already completed the preparations.
